instruction: Use command-line automation only for this task. Operate the installed SOLIDWORKS CAM 2025 environment through the CAMWorks API; do not use GUI clicks, GUI automation, generic G-code generators, prebuilt helper wrappers, or manual .nc editing/copying. For the steps below, SOLIDWORKS CAM/CAMWorks is hosted by `C:\Program Files\SOLIDWORKS Corp\SOLIDWORKS\SLDWORKS.exe`; run the native CAM automation through that installation. Load C:\Users\User\Desktop\multi_feature.step and read C:\Users\User\Desktop\tool_library.csv. Create a native CAM part from the STEP model. Use G54 with the model top-face center at model coordinates [0, 0, 18] mm and tool axis -Z, so the posted model top is Z=0. Use exactly the three listed tools and no others: T1, a 16 mm face mill at S7000 rpm and F500 mm/min, for one Face operation that removes the 0.5 mm top stock allowance across the 120 x 80 mm face; T2, an 8 mm flat end mill at S8000 rpm and F450 mm/min, for one Pocket operation that clears the central 48 x 28 mm pocket to Z=-10 mm and one Profile operation that cuts the complete 120 x 80 mm outside perimeter to Z=-18 mm with correct cutter-radius compensation; and T3, a 5 mm drill at S5000 rpm and F180 mm/min, for one Drill operation that machines the four through holes centered at (X,Y)=(-35,-20), (-35,20), (35,-20), and (35,20) mm to at least Z=-18 mm. Generate the native operation plan and toolpaths, run native SOLIDWORKS CAM simulation/verification for all four operations with no gouges or undercuts, and post-process with the installed SOLIDWORKS CAM postprocessor. Save the posted NC output exactly as C:\Users\User\Desktop\task-05.nc.
source: Installed SOLIDWORKS CAM 2025 / CAMWorks API; official SOLIDWORKS CAM product and training documentation: https://www.solidworks.com/product/solidworks-cam ; https://www.solidworks.com/support/training/solidworks-cam-standard
